about.title: About
about.subtitle: Full-Stack Developer focused on modern architecture, clean code, and user experience.
about.bioTitle: Building complete, high-performance, and secure web applications.
about.bioP1: Full-Stack Developer specializing in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, I build web applications from end to end: from database design and server APIs to polished, reactive user interfaces.
about.bioP2: My approach combines TypeScript, data validation with Zod, and attention to security: client-side encryption in Temporis and authentication services integrated into my applications. I also use AI tools such as Cursor and Codex to accelerate development while keeping the code readable and maintainable.
about.pillarsSubtitle: Building reliable, maintainable, and high-performance applications from end to end.
about.pillar1Desc: TypeScript to describe data and code contracts, Zod to validate inputs at runtime.
about.pillar2Desc: Next.js rendering and route prefetching to reduce loading and make navigation smoother.
about.pillar3Desc: Reliable authentication with Clerk or Firebase, protected API routes, and secure handling of sensitive data.
about.pillar4Desc: Modular architecture, structured and readable code to build applications that are easy to maintain and scale.
